summary: feat(settings): adopt Nova icons and illustrations behind the flag
description:
Because:
- Nova replaces FxA's icons and illustrations with acorn-icons and the Mozilla accounts set.
- acorn-icons use context-fill, which renders black outside Firefox chrome.

This commit:
- Adds Mozilla accounts illustrations and Figma exports (recovery methods, avatar), via svgo.
- Adds acorn-icons with context-fill rewritten to currentColor, via svgo.
- Adds withNova/sized helpers and sets the Storybook Nova theme during render.
- Keeps the Nova Switch 64x26 at every width; turns Nova on in local.json-dist.
- Documents the asset tables and unswapped list in the design-tokens README.
